backfill_news.headline: Darling Ingredients Q2 2026 earnings: Strong profitability with $387.3M net income, raises core guidance
backfill_news.summary: Darling Ingredients reported Q2 2026 net income of $387.3M ($2.41 EPS), a massive 30x jump YoY driven by strong fats and protein prices, and Diamond Green Diesel strength. The company guides Q3 core EBITDA of $325–$340M and expects to end 2026 with net debt at or below $3B and leverage below 2X.

backfill_news.headline: Clean Harbors Q2 2026: Record revenue of $1.74B, adjusted EBITDA margin reaches 23.6%, secures $600M long-term disposal contract
backfill_news.summary: Clean Harbors posted record Q2 revenue of $1.74B (+12% YoY) with adjusted EBITDA of $409M (+22% YoY). The company announced a major 10-year, $600M disposal contract with a manufacturing customer expected to generate $80–$100M annual run rate by 2030, and raised full-year 2026 guidance.
